work.pieces.heading: Pieces
work.pieces.ask: Ask another agent to work on a piece…
work.pieces.title: ask another agent to work on a piece
work.pieces.says: Another agent writes one piece of this session’s work in a clone of its own, from the commit this session stands at, and changes nothing here. Daoris keeps what it wrote as one commit for this session to merge, and its answer comes back to this session as claims to check.
work.pieces.paths: Paths it is about (optional, separated by spaces)
work.pieces.asked: Asked: the driver judges the piece at its next look, and starts it only where that agent’s confinement as a partner was measured.
work.pieces.noAgent: No other agent is set up on this machine to write a piece.
work.pieces.state.held: Held: its work was not taken into the repository
work.pieces.state.uncertain: Uncertain: Daoris restarted while it worked
work.pieces.stopSays: Its partner’s turn ends now. What it wrote so far is kept as the piece’s work, and its answer comes back to this session.
work.pieces.refused.blank: Write the piece the other agent is to work on.
work.pieces.refused.too-long: A piece is at most 4000 characters: shorten it.
work.pieces.refused.agent: Choose the agent that writes the piece.
work.pieces.refused.path: A path leads outside the repository: name paths inside it.
work.pieces.refused.not-held: This session is not held on this machine, so no piece could come back to it.
work.pieces.refused.unfit: This session cannot lead a piece: only a session working in a tree of its own does.
work.pieces.refused.no-commit: This session’s tree has no commit to grow a piece from.
